'''Kalro Mear''' was a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] from [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]]. Mear was hired by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Spitar P'ton]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] along with a dozen assistants to be his personal chef.
